items.title: Delete the stray 'orphans' junk file at repo root

items.title: Delete 3 confirmed-dead source modules and verify no residual references
items.context: git rm packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts, packages/main/src/core/phase-protocol.ts, packages/main/src/verifier/bridge-utils.ts. Each has 0 import statements and 0 external uses of its exported symbols (verified). Confirm after deletion that `git grep -nE 'intent-coverage|phase-protocol|bridge-utils' -- packages` shows no live code import (story-metadata/.lattice mentions are fine), and that the superseded behaviors (intent coverage, phase gate) still exist elsewhere. `npm run build` (tsc) and `npm run test:e2e` must pass.
